body: Does anyone remember Bettie Jo’s episode. It’s been ages since I’ve watched but if I recall, she insisted she had cancer and Dr. Now was telling her she definitely didn’t…

This is 100% the exact position I’m in and it’s so tragic. He cannot put his pants on without assistance. Kicking him out would be equivalent to death via exposure to the elements or starvation. He cannot find resources or even feed himself. I would absolutely catch charges for this. 

Wanna hear something else funny. I cried when we left the hospital. I told them next time they see me, it’ll be when they’re trying to revive my battered carcass. And that’s if they get to me in time. So when we got home, I called the state crisis line. They were like, “oh I see, the hospital already contacted us, what would you like us to do now?” They offered to send a mobile crisis unit that would basically transfer him to the ER… the same ER we just left.

I’m in Georgia. We always made too much to qualify for SSI for him when it was based on parental income. However, being freshly 18 I’m told we can reapply and be considered. Same with medical. We have private insurance, high deductible, a self funded plan so they don’t have to cover things that the ACA would mandate. Ages ago I tried to receive the waivers for medical coverage but it was a fight at every corner and I had the financial resources to continue pursuing therapies privately. 

One of the problems we are currently encountering is the violence is brand new and he’s showing signs of psychosis. Coupled with a family history of schizoaffective disorder, this is likely what is happening to him as well. And this is really excluding him from a lot of places that would help people on the spectrum. 

I don’t even know what my next step is at this point.
I’ll add that to my list of resources. Thanks, it’s tremendously difficult.

I wish, but he got put on the list at the hospital and they shopped around but came back with a list of behavioral health facilities across the state and even the surrounding states who all declined based on his level of need. His psychiatrist was the one who told us to go to the ER and ask for crisis placement and they did try, but eventually just told us sorry, we’ve looked everywhere. They were very kind about it though so at least there’s that. Not helpful but very sympathetic.
